title: Why 1,200 AI Agents Started Working Together | Ryan Greenblatt

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Ryan Greenblatt, Chief Scientist at Redwood Research.
reader_summary.overview: Ryan Greenblatt, Chief Scientist at Redwood Research. Ryan and his collaborators found agents spontaneously organizing through message boards, sharing information, assigning tasks, forming teams. Rather than simply trying to steal answers, hundreds of agents were working together on elaborate strategies to manipulate how their performance would be scored.

key_points.text: Ryan Greenblatt, Chief Scientist at Redwood Research.
Ryan and his collaborators found agents spontaneously organizing through message boards, sharing information, assigning tasks, forming teams.
Theo and Ryan discuss why this level of coordination was surprising, how reward hacking may emerge during training.
